physicalEvidence.summary: Full November 2024 Applied Sciences paper trains PPO in Gazebo and deploys fixed weights on a real TurtleBot using live LiDAR in three indoor mazes. Evaluation is five runs of 100 navigation trials per maze; success is 95.2%, 72.4% and 88.1%, so the abstract’s over-88% statement must not be generalized across layouts. Parameters are not updated during physical testing. It is actual closed-loop navigation, not merely a simulator or dataset. The 2025 SPIE contraction/parallel-Kinova titles lack inspected full methods and receive no extra hardware credit. Current 2026 federated-RL paper uses MuJoCo simulation. Corresponding author; topic/framework and experiment-design contributions are explicit, but no independent current advisee or sole-platform ownership was established, so physical20.

name: Minghan Wei
title: Assistant Professor; SIMA Lab lead
department: Electrical Engineering and Computer Science; Scalable Intelligence for Motion and Autonomy Lab
fitReason: Direct integration of VLM scene reasoning and learned visual grounding into an actual mobile-manipulator navigation loop.

physicalEvidence.summary: Full CVPR 2026 workshop paper implements a Clearpath Jackal with 2D LiDAR, RealSense camera and manipulator. When a closed door blocks a geometric plan, GPT-5 suggests a door-button interaction and a CLIP-based detector localizes it, enabling a physical button press and resumed navigation. This is a proof-of-concept office-building demonstration. The reported 85% localization metric is from 20 additional images, not a general end-to-end navigation success rate; completion is conditional on successful localization, and the paper does not state a broad physical-trial count. Elevators and diverse blockage interactions remain future extensions. Current lab roster independently identifies coauthor Shuaib Olanrewaju as an undergraduate RA; Jerry Gambrell appears as an alumnus. The older shared 2024 PPO paper is supplementary, not the sole basis for ownership.

shortVisit.summary: Current lab has graduate and undergraduate researchers, but the inspected official page, personal site and team roster do not establish an external-master short-visitor offer.
